title: Transfer: Kubernetes Pod Egress Triage
goal: Use per-pod egress metric summaries from a cluster monitor to produce a JSON incident queue that labels each pod for port-scan, flood-like DoS, beaconing, or benign behavior and records the highest-priority reason.
skillBenefitRationale: The cloud-native context is different from the source PCAP task, but the only decisive shipped capability is still the exact threat-detection thresholds for scan, DoS, and beaconing.
